title: Track export performance
goal: Show how file size affects export latency so the team can set a reliable performance budget.

steps.title: Define the benchmark
steps.detail: Agree on the measurement window, file sizes, and units.
steps.outcome: Both exporters run against the same benchmark inputs.

steps.title: Instrument the exporters
steps.detail: Capture elapsed time and bytes written in the export worker.
steps.outcome: Each run records latency and file size in the benchmark log.

examples.caption: How a worker retries a failed export

steps.title: Prepare repeatable fixtures
steps.detail: Create seeded export inputs for the three target file sizes.
steps.outcome: The benchmark can regenerate all three inputs on demand.

steps.title: Publish the latency report
steps.detail: Run both exporters over the fixtures and summarize the measurements.
steps.outcome: The team has a baseline latency curve for both exporters.
